headline: Names a Postal Service facility in Orangeburg, South Carolina, the J.I. Washington Post Office Building.
what_it_does: This law renames a U.S. Postal Service facility at 1550 State Road S-38-211 in Orangeburg, South Carolina. The building will be called the J.I. Washington Post Office Building. It does not change postal services, rules, or costs.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 27, 2022.
